title: A CTNNB1-altered medulloblastoma shows the immunophenotypic, DNA methylation and transcriptomic profiles of SHH-activated, and not WNT-activated, medulloblastoma.
authors: Chiang, Jason; Moreira, Daniel C; Pytel, Nicholas J; Liu, Yen-Chun; Blackburn, Patrick R; Shi, Zonggao; Cardenas, Maria; Wheeler, David A; Furtado, Larissa V
one_liner_zh: 该文报道一例CTNNB1突变髓母细胞瘤的免疫表型、甲基化和转录组特征，属于临床肿瘤分子分型案例，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Recent advancements in molecular characterisation have identified four principal molecular groups of medulloblastoma: WNT, SHH, group 3 and group 4. Each has its characteristic clinical features, signature genetic alterations and distinct DNA methylome profiles. Thus far, CTNNB1 mutations have been considered pathognomonic of WNT-activated medulloblastoma. Furthermore, it has been shown that CTNNB1 mutations dominantly drive the WNT-activated phenotype in medulloblastoma, even in the presence of alterations in the SHH pathway. We herein report an illustrative case that challenges this belief-a medulloblastoma with a pathogenic CTNNB1 mutation that otherwise showed the histopathology, immunophenotype and methylation and transcriptomic profiles of an SHH-activated medulloblastoma. Detailed molecular analyses, including whole exome sequencing, transcriptome analysis and DNA methylation profiling with DKFZ brain tumour classifier and St. Jude MLPnet neural network classifier analyses, have been performed on the tumour. Our example emphasises the diagnostic value of the immunohistochemistry panel with YAP1, GAB1 and beta-catenin and DNA methylation profiling, combined with exome sequencing, in the characterisation of medulloblastoma. CTNNB1 mutations are not specific for WNT-activated medulloblastoma, and different CTNNB1 mutations have diverse oncogenic potential.
abstract_zh: 分子特征研究的最新进展已鉴定出髓母细胞瘤的四个主要分子亚组：WNT、SHH、第3组和第4组。每个亚组具有其独特的临床特征、特征性遗传改变和不同的DNA甲基化谱。迄今为止，CTNNB1突变被认为是WNT激活型髓母细胞瘤的病理特征性标志。此外，研究表明，即使存在SHH通路改变，CTNNB1突变在髓母细胞瘤中仍主导驱动WNT激活表型。本文报告一例挑战这一观点的典型病例——一例携带致病性CTNNB1突变的髓母细胞瘤，但其组织病理学、免疫表型以及甲基化和转录组谱均表现为SHH激活型髓母细胞瘤。对该肿瘤进行了详细的分子分析，包括全外显子组测序、转录组分析以及使用DKFZ脑肿瘤分类器和St. Jude MLPnet神经网络分类器进行的DNA甲基化谱分析。我们的病例强调了免疫组化组合（包括YAP1、GAB1和β-catenin）与DNA甲基化谱分析，结合外显子组测序，在髓母细胞瘤特征鉴定中的诊断价值。CTNNB1突变并非WNT激活型髓母细胞瘤所特有，且不同的CTNNB1突变具有不同的致癌潜力。
